notes: Phase 1 Step 3 (LLM API candidate labeling) for ray, Pass 2 / CWE-78 Command/Argument Injection, against the ray_vuln source tree (sha 79a5643 == CodeQL database creation sha; every CSV line was re-read from the tree and each entry's first evidence string is the verbatim source line at its location).

Single-pass labeling run: Pass 2 only, per exploration/detection.json target.pass=2 and the task scope. The WORKFLOW pass-2 family is CWE 077/078/088, but all labeling decisions were made strictly under CWE-78 (OS command injection) semantics, so cwes is ["078"].

passes contains a pass_id=1 stub with zero entries solely to satisfy labels_schema.json's 'contains' clause (it requires a pass_id=1 element); pass 1 (path traversal) was NOT labeled in this run and must be labeled separately before any pass-1 query generation.

All 3828 candidate rows (sources.csv 3296 + sinks.csv 532) were dispositioned - zero rows skipped; 'fp'/'none'/'candidate' are explicit labeled outcomes, not omissions. Duplicate CSV rows for the same AST site were merged (see labels_raw_pass2.json dedup_log): source-side api+ast decode facets, sink-side arg/ast/shell_true/cmd_format/wrapper facets of one exec call.

Labeling was performed in-session by the agent's underlying LLM (glm-5.3) in 7 batches (dashboard boundary sources; serve/client/runtime-env sources; CLI boundaries; env reads; open/decode rows; runtime-core sinks; CI/release/doc sinks); no external LLM API calls were made and no code execution tool was used on the target tree.

classification semantics: tp = confirmed genuine for the assigned role in this pass (NOT a vulnerability ground-truth verdict); fp = candidate rejected; candidate = plausible but unresolved, kept for conservative recall and queued for human review; unknown = unused this run.

Threat model used: remote boundaries are the unauthenticated dashboard head/agent HTTP API, the node-local runtime env agent HTTP server, the reporter/log gRPC servicers, the ray client gRPC server, serve ingress and the tune web UI; CLI args, environment variables, cluster config YAMLs and other local files are local-operator boundaries (labeled candidate-level, never auto-promoted to tp). Not every network message field was accepted as a source and not every subprocess call was accepted as a confirmed sink - each site's command construction (shell=True vs argv list, static literal vs interpolation) was read in the source.

flow_kind mapping per labels_schema.json: request-state/message/env/cli attribute reads -> field; decode returns (json/yaml/getenv/pydantic parse_obj/open content) -> return; handler/servicer/CLI function parameters -> param; sink exec arguments -> argument (arg_index 0, or 1 for os.execvp whose tainted operand is the args list); internal_exec_wrapper entries use unknown.

No sanitizer entries: int() coercion at reporter_head.py:348/:416 neutralizes pid/duration but not the raw 'format' string; shlex.quote in the autoscaler (command_runner.py:86, docker.py, commands.py:77) quotes only selected fragments while caller cmd strings are appended raw; pydantic validation in the job/serve pipelines is shape validation only. None of these is a complete barrier for CWE-78, so MySanitizers should stay empty for this pass.

No PyVul ground truth, vulnerability patch commits, or external security advisories were consulted; project source, the CodeQL database, the Augur installation and the extraction artifacts were not modified (only files under iris_manual/ray/iris/labels were written).
